description: Use this skill whenever an agent is about to write something it has not verified — a call to a helper whose signature it inferred from the name, an enum case that sounds plausible, a config key, a column, a file path mentioned in a plan but never opened, a docblock explaining a mechanism nobody read, a commit message asserting what the code does. Also when the user says the agent invented an API, hallucinated a method, confidently described behaviour that does not exist, or asks how to stop it happening. It gives the rule (ask, or log the doubt — never the silent third option), what must be verified, and how autonomous mode changes the answer without removing the obligation. Do not use it for verifying facts about the outside world, for prompt engineering, or for reviewing code somebody else wrote.
